experimental_design: For SILAC experiments, cells were stimulated in the appropriate SILAC-formulated media.
factor_value: For shotgun proteomic analysis, ~ 1.0 × 107 cells were harvested from control (light), 4 h IFNβ stimulation (medium), and 24 h IFNβ stimulation (heavy).
number_of_biological_replicates: Autocorrelations were calculated as the Pearson correlation between pairs of stimulated and unstimulated chromatograms, normalized to z scores, and aggregated across all three replicates using Stouffer’s method.
number_of_fractions: Fractions were collected every 40 s for 60 min.
technology_type: Purified peptides were analyzed using an Easy nano LC 1000 nanoflow HPLC (Thermo Fisher) on-line coupled to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).
